direct_answer: Aker BP integrates sustainability-related performance into its incentive schemes through a company-wide bonus scheme in which sustainability-related initiatives and targets affect the payout: approximately 22% of the bonus potential is dependent on sustainability-related initiatives and targets. The bonus is paid to all permanent employees, including management, and is calculated with the same share of bonus potential for all employees. The sustainability-related KPIs referenced include safety (serious incidents per million work hours) and equity share scope 1 GHG intensity (kg CO2e/boe) (while the “people and organisation” KPI is stated not to factor into the bonus). Governance-wise, the Organisational Development and Compensation Committee (ODCC) is responsible for ensuring remuneration arrangements support the company’s strategy and oversees the setting of targets and monitoring of progress related to KPIs linked to the incentive schemes for executive management team (EMT) remuneration.
